components.component_name: Lamb salona (Gulf-style meat and vegetable stew)
components.chef: مطبخ سيدتي (Sayidaty Kitchen, no individual chef named); published 2026-03-16
method: In a large pot over medium heat, melt the ghee and cook the minced onions until soft and golden.
Add the garlic and stir about 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, green peppers, carrots and all the spices; stir well.
Add the potatoes, the pre-boiled meat and enough broth to cover. Simmer gently about 1 hour until meat is tender and vegetables are fully cooked.
Taste and adjust salt.
Serve hot garnished with chopped parsley or coriander, with white rice or flatbread.

components.component_name: Stuffed cabbage rolls over chicken (Manal Alalem)
method: Bring 8 cups water with the cumin to a boil in a deep pot.
Cut a slit around the cabbage core so leaves separate, drop the head into the boiling water, and lift leaves out one by one as they soften.
Cut the leaves into even pieces (remove thick ribs).
Spread the chicken pieces over the base of a thick-bottomed pot, season with salt, pepper, mixed spice and turmeric, toss and arrange flat.
In a deep bowl mix rice, ground meat, minced onion, salt, mixed spice and oil/ghee until combined.
Place about 1 tbsp filling along the edge of each leaf, roll into a finger shape, and lay the rolls over the chicken; tuck the garlic halves between rolls.
Mix lemon juice, pomegranate molasses and 3 cups water in a measuring jug.
Place the pot on medium heat for 20 minutes WITHOUT the broth, with a heavy heat-proof plate pressed on top of the rolls so they stay closed.
Add the broth gradually, boil 20 minutes, then lower the heat, cover and cook until the rice has absorbed all the liquid and is fully tender.
Invert the pot onto a serving dish; serve with Arabic bread and yogurt.
components.chicken_or_meat_spec: 6 chicken thigh/drumstick pieces as the pot base plus 200 g ground meat in the filling
components.rice_type_and_ratio: 2 cups short-grain Egyptian rice in filling; cooking liquid 1/2 cup lemon juice + 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses + 3 cups water

components.component_name: Alternative: classic cabbage rolls with rice and ground meat (Sayidaty)
method: Wash cabbage leaves and boil in a pot of water about 5 minutes until soft; drain and cool.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat; sauté onion and garlic until wilted.
Add ground meat and cook, stirring, until no longer pink; stir in grated tomato, tomato paste, spices, salt and pepper.
Add rice, parsley, dill and coriander; mix well.
Add about 1/2 cup water and simmer on low about 7 minutes until the rice starts to cook; remove and cool slightly.
Put a portion of filling on each leaf, roll snugly folding in the edges.
Arrange rolls in a deep pot, add chicken stock to cover, weigh down with a heavy plate.
Bring to a boil on medium, reduce to low and simmer 45 to 60 minutes until rice and cabbage are fully cooked. Serve hot.
components.rice_type_and_ratio: 2 cups Egyptian short-grain rice; cooked in chicken stock to cover

components.source_site: cookpad.com (last resort; no Cajun chicken recipe found on Sayidaty, Manal or Shamlola, only Cajun pasta/potato/shrimp)
method: Clean the chicken, drain well in a strainer until dry.
Mix all dry spices in a bowl, stir in lemon juice, then oil.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken, making cuts (ideally under the skin) so the marinade penetrates.
Refrigerate 2 hours or longer.
Place chicken in a baking tray, pour over all the marinade, top with onion slices if desired, cover with two layers of foil.
Bake in a preheated oven about 1 hour or more until fully cooked (page gives no temperature).
Remove foil to brown the chicken. Serve with rice and salad.

components.component_name: Lobia (dried cowpea/black-eyed bean) in tomato sauce

ingredients.item_en: dried lobia beans (variety not stated; soaked 6 h)

method: Wash the lobia and soak at least 6 hours.
Boil the soaked beans in salted water about 40 minutes until tender; drain.
Heat oil in a pot, add minced onion and stir until golden.
Add tomato juice and cook over medium heat until the sauce thickens.
Season with salt, pepper and spices; add the cooked beans and stir.
Simmer on low at least 30 minutes until beans are fully cooked and sauce is rich. Serve hot with rice.

components.servings_stated: 4 persons; prep 30 min, cook 70 min (plus 6 h to overnight marinating)
method: Wash the chicken and drain in a colander until dry.
In a small bowl mix garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, both vinegars and soy sauce; add salt, paprika, cinnamon, spices, thyme and basil and mix again.
Rub marinade over the chicken inside, outside and under the skin; place in a bag and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
Preheat oven to 190°C.
Set the chicken on a roasting rack in a tray.
Roast 70 minutes until cooked through and golden brown, basting from time to time with remaining marinade.
Serve hot with basmati rice and fried potatoes.

method: Put the minced molokhia in a pot over the heat; add 1/2 tbsp of the garlic and 1/2 tbsp of the coriander.
Gradually add hot broth, stirring, until medium consistency (neither thick nor watery). Do not let it boil hard; remove from heat as soon as it is hot through.
In a separate small pan heat 2 tbsp ghee, add the remaining minced garlic and stir briefly.
Add the remaining coriander and stir until the garlic turns reddish-gold, then pour this 'ta'leya' over the molokhia and cover. Serve hot.

components.component_name: Spaghetti with meatballs in tomato sauce
method: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente; drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking water.
Mix minced meat, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper by hand until smooth; shape into small even balls.
Heat oil in a wide pot over medium-high; fry meatballs in batches until browned on all sides; set aside.
In the same pot soften the onion, add garlic and cook about 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, oregano, salt, pepper, the 1/4 cup water and the reserved pasta water; bring to a simmer.
Return meatballs to the sauce, cover, and simmer on low about 20 minutes until meatballs are cooked through and sauce thickened.
Serve spaghetti topped with meatballs and sauce, garnished with Parmesan and parsley.

components.component_name: Spinach stew with chicken (classic, with rice)
components.source_site: kitchen.sayidaty.net (Shamlola had no classic spinach-chicken stew; its only match is an oven-baked stuffed roll, see notes)
method: Melt 1 tbsp ghee in a pot, add chicken pieces, the halved onion, bay leaves, cinnamon and water; simmer about 20 minutes until chicken is cooked; strain and keep the broth.
Wash and chop the spinach; in a second pot heat 1 tbsp oil/ghee with the chopped onion, add spinach and stir until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper, pour in the strained chicken broth and the chicken pieces, and cook until spinach is tender and the stew has thickened.
Rice: soak 3 cups short-grain rice 15 min, drain; heat oil in a pot, add rice, water and salt; cook 5 min on high then lower the heat and cook until done.
Serve the spinach and chicken hot beside the rice.

components.component_name: Madhbi chicken on coarse salt with spiced basmati rice (video recipe)
components.chef: لمى شهاب (Lama Shehab, Sayidaty chefs); published 2017-09-22
method: Season the chicken quarters with the mixed spice and black pepper.

Spread an even layer of coarse salt in a wide heavy pan, lay the chicken skin-down on the salt over medium heat, and leave undisturbed until cooked and the skin is crisp (the video shows the full timing; page gives none).
In a pot melt the ghee; add onion, bay leaves, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, turmeric and mixed spice; add the halved chilies and diced tomatoes with a small pinch of salt.
Add the basmati rice and stir to coat.
Pour in 6 cups chicken broth, bring to a boil, then cook on low heat, covered, until the rice is done.
Spoon rice onto a platter, top with the chicken, serve hot.
